featured_reviews.review_text:
Dropped by Desert Republic in Bandra West on a Sunday night, thanks to some serious post-dinner sugar cravings. It’s a cozy little dessert café just off Linking Road, and unusually for Bandra, they even offer valet parking a big plus.

🍴 What We Tried

Cros-Ice-Ants – their own creation, a cross between a croissant and an ice-cream sandwich. Buttery, flaky croissant meets syrup and creamy ice cream honestly, this is a must-try. Perfect indulgence.

Sugar-Free Dark Hot Chocolate  surprisingly good! Smooth, warm, and satisfying even without sugar.

✨ Ambience & Service
The space is small but warm and inviting, great for a late-night dessert run. Staff was polite and helpful, making the visit even better.

⭐ Overall Verdict
If you’re in Bandra and craving something sweet after dinner, Desert Therapy lives up to its name. Don’t leave without trying the Cros-Ice-Ants — it’s dessert therapy at its finest.

featured_reviews.name: Suyash Karangutkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Gold by Ice Cream Works and had an absolutely delightful experience! We started with their 70% Dark Chocolate Ganache with Choco Rocks scoop — a dream for dark chocolate lovers. It was rich, with just the right balance of bittersweet notes, and the texture of the choco rocks added a perfect crunch, making it wonderfully pallete-balancing.

Next, we tried the Ferro Hazelnut, which was dipped in chocolate and absolutely delicious — a treat that beautifully captured the classic hazelnut and chocolate combination. As a healthier choice, we also sampled their Good-For-You Chocolate (pun game strong!) a chocolate ice cream sweetened with palm jaggery. The natural sweetness of the jaggery was spot on, making it feel indulgent yet light, and we appreciated the clever pun in the name!

The ambiance of the place was cozy and inviting, and the staff were extremely welcoming, cordial, and helpful in suggesting flavors based on our preferences. They made the experience even more enjoyable.

We also noticed an entire section dedicated to caramel ice-cream cakes, which looked very tempting — definitely on our list for the next visit! Plus, their Sundae menu is quite elaborate, offering plenty of options for those looking to indulge.

Overall, a must-visit spot for ice cream and dessert enthusiasts. Can’t wait to go back and try more!

They specialise in premium flavours which are unique and give you an artisanal experience. Every flavour is amazing here and the menu is never ending. Also they have a kid centric special menu which is really good. Loved the sundaes as they are completely Instgrammable. Prices are on the higher side however the quantity and quantity are unmatched.

Went here after dinner and the staff were really polite and they knew their brand well. Special thanks to Manager Imran & Staff Tausif for their service.

What We Had -
SCOOPS~
3 Berries Cheesecake.
Biscotti Chocolate Cookie Fudge.
Both the flavours were bang on tasty and it was not overly sweet. The taste of tangy sweet berries was evident and the chocolate cookie fudge had cookie crumbs put nicely.

SUNDAES~
Chocolate in Gold Perfection.
Alphonso Mango.
They are the masters in preparing sundaes as the mix of flavours plus presentation is top class.  Chocolate in gold perfection was way too heavy for the appetite as it had everything related to chocolate in it. The best was the Alphonso mango from their limited edition menu which was outstanding.

MILKSHAKES~
Pistachio Opulence.
Alphanso Mango Milkshake.
Amazingly thick shakes made perfectly which tasted excellent. Loved the pistachio opulence and it should definitely be tried. Again not too sweet but tasty till the last drop.

So our dessert trip at Gold by ICW Bandra was something different as the Gourmet flavours and the classy outlet is something you need to visit for a memorable dessert experience.

featured_reviews.name: Kinjal Jethwa
featured_reviews.review_text:
Indulge Creamery Cafe is one of Bandra West’s newest and buzzy café-creamery spots. A hybrid ice-cream creamery + café destination - a concept that blends premium desserts with comforting café fare. The space is bright, stylish & Instagram-friendly - soft pink walls, bold green tiles, mirrored accents, and modern lighting create a playful yet premium feel. It’s designed to have cozy conversations, quick meet-ups, or dessert dates. This cafe open up early morning at 7am serving varities of breakfast options including healthy smoothie bowl and closes till late night 3am that fulfills your dessert urges. The menu is smartly curated with breakfast options to quick bites that goes along with beverages and drinks.
• The ice cream Sundae are a highlight — imaginative, premium-quality scoops with toppings that nod to global inspiration but tailored for Indian tastes. The Strawberry Greek Yogurt Sundae was just awesome and yumm.
• The Mocktails, Milkshakes are rich, indulgent, and often photogenic. Loved its Strawberry Matcha and Citrus Matcha Mojito.
• Artisanal single-origin coffees — thoughtfully sourced and crafted, with espresso, affogato-style drinks, lattes, etc.
• The café side isn’t just desserts but burgers, sandwiches and light bites are on the menu, designed to balance the sweetness. Top comfort eats are Avocado Toast, Pesto Crossiant, Bagel Ceasar Sandwich and Watermelon feta salad — great for pairing with shakes or coffees.
If you want a quiet work-friendly café — this is more about the vibe, visuals, and indulgence.

featured_reviews.name: Ankur Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re craving indulgent hot or cold chocolate in Mumbai, Chantilly and Chantilly Works, Bandra is an absolute must-visit.

They serve one of the best strawberry chocolates and hot/cold chocolates the city has to offer. It’s clearly a favorite among many—and honestly, I completely get why.

Yes, it may seem a bit pricey at first, but the quality and experience make it totally worth it. I’d highly recommend trying their 75% dark chocolate version—rich, intense, and perfectly balanced.

A little personal ritual I swear by:
I usually order a hot chocolate, enjoy half there, and take the rest home. Refrigerate it overnight and have it cold the next day—it tastes incredible!

One thing to note: the seating space is very small—just a few tables. If you visit at night, be prepared for a wait, even for takeaway sometimes.

I’m not even a big chocolate person, but this place is an exception I happily make.

Must visit when your chocolate cravings hit! 🍫

featured_reviews.review_text:
After a fabulous lunch , I went to this place . I had heard good things about this place . So decided to explore , dessert is the thing that gives you happiness . Summer season going on , so i was excited to try out the new menu .

“SHAHI DURBAR “ is the place to have desserts and some quick bites . It is a small outlet located at Carter road. Being a kulfi fan , this place is must to visit . Different types in sundaes , kulfi and some signature milkshakes make this place attractive.

The ambience is Simple but decorative,but the place is too small .
Service was also good , as the staff was friendly .

WHAT I HAD

1)SHAHI DURBAR SPECIAL PIZZA - So recently they have added pizza and pasta in the menu . the pizza tasted delicious, melting mozzarella cheese tasted amazing. It was topped with olives , the views impact was huge .

2)PENNE PASTA IN COCKTAIL SAUCE - Penne pasta in a cocktail sauce, cocktail sauce is combination of both red and white sauce . It was perfectly cooked. It tasted pretty good . It tasted a bit sweet

3)MANGO SUNDAE - Summer season going on , This mango sundae has 3 things . Mango ice cream along with mango kulfi slices , topped with mango fruit . Flavourful taste with classic presentation. Would recommend it .

4)BLUEBERRY AND STRAWBERRY MILKSHAKE- A proper thick milkshake having fresh taste of both the fruits . Perfectly thick with perfect amount of sweetness.

5)BELGIUM CHOCOLATE GALETO - A Belgium chocolate stick dipped in a Nutella sauce , was topped with choco chips . It had rich chocolate flavour , tasted amazing. Over all heaven for chocolate lovers .

6)COCONUT GALETO - Another Classic galeto dipped in a Nutella sauce, topped with pista and almond . Creamy coconut rich taste at the best . The coconut and Nutella combination went well .

7)SHAHI DURBAR SPECIAL FALOODA - “AMAZING”! Don’t have other word to describe this . Falooda noodles along with basil and different flavours of kulfi . The base was flavourful, overall it tasted amazing. The quantity was also sufficient. Definitely worth to have it .

On the whole it was classic experience. Though it is small place but still Loved the variety of desserts , I would surely recommend this place .

Looking forward to my next visit .
Food 5/5
Service 5/5
Ambience 4/5
For kulfi 5/5
Recommend 5/5
Value for money 5/5

Keep traveling, keep eating, keep Clicking.

you're ever around Pali Hill, Bandra West, and looking for a cozy, aesthetic spot to chill with friends or even get some work done, Ritual Daily Coffee should definitely be on your list. Whether you're looking for a new coffee hangout, a place to work, or just craving some standout food, Ritual Daily Coffee is definitely worth the visit.

featured_reviews.name: Tanishka Rajpal
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re looking for a warm and cozy café in Bandra West, Rituals Café is such a lovely find! From the moment you walk in, the vibe feels inviting – it has that cute, aesthetic charm that makes you want to sit down, relax, and just spend hours there. The upper deck seating is one of my favorite parts – perfect for catching up with friends, getting some work done, or even just enjoying a quiet coffee by yourself.

Coming to the food – I tried their mac & cheese and it was exactly what comfort food should taste like: creamy, cheesy, and super satisfying. The avo toast with burrata was fresh and delicious, such a perfect combination. For dessert, I went with their gluten-free chocolate cake and honestly, I couldn’t believe it was gluten-free – it was rich, fudgy, and just the right amount of sweetness. I also loved their 54% sugar-free Belgian chocolate – guilt-free but still indulgent. To finish, I had the Brazilian blueberry smoothie, which was refreshing, light, and packed with flavor.

What I really like is that everything feels thoughtfully made, and the presentation is just as good as the taste. It’s not just a café, but a spot where you can actually unwind and feel good while enjoying great food. Definitely one of those hidden gems in Bandra that I’ll be revisiting for sure. Highly recommend to anyone who loves cozy corners, comfort food, and cute café vibes! 💛

featured_reviews.name: ragini konar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The BEST gelato sorbet bar in the town 🍨🍦
I’m so glad to have found this place.
Everything I’ve tried and loved (UNSPONSORED HAHA)
-dark chocolate sesame combo or as is
-curry patta pineapple jalapeño combo or as is
-orange chocolate
-watermelon sorbet
AND VEGAN 😮‍💨😋
If you are looking for just another icecream store you’d probably leave disappointed; because koldkarobar is here to standout and rightly so.
The service here isn’t rushed and feels less commercial hence
The gelato flavours are so rich and creamy and the sorbets ahhhh teleported to an Italian gelato bar with the fresh clean ingredients only here they let you try as many flavours and have the coolest ambience
The first time I tasted the dark chocolate OMG to discover it is sweetened with dates (TAKE ALL MY MONEY)
It’s so cool how mindful they are:- From serving tasting portions on both sides of the spoon hence being less wasteful, to using coconut shell as the bin to discard the spoons.
The store design is the most functional and the thing in itself to admire.
Cheers to many more unrushed slow calmer icecream sessions at koldkarobar.

featured_reviews.name: Shaurya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kold Karobar is tucked away in the bylanes of Chapel Road and it genuinely feels like a breath of fresh air from Bandra’s endless cafes and coffee spots.

The Shop is itself on wheels, modular, designed with so much intent and care.

Pranshu (the owner) the coolest cat and gelato maestro is  there himself just churning out fresh batches, which just makes it all feel more personal.

Also there’s something really nice about just relaxing there and watching people enjoy their gelatos, random conversations, little jokes, people lingering around, and the familiarity with which Pranshu engages his patrons as well.

I’ve been three times now. Keep going back to the orange chocolate. Recently tried the snickers sundae and it is going to be my go-to order henceforth.

Also cherry on top is that it is fully plant-based, cruelty-free, which just makes the whole thing even better.

can’t recommend it enough.
